status: requests; nothing here is a decision until the owner records it with tools/owner-freeze.fsx decide historical-compatibility
recordFormat: A change in an operator approval APR-HC-OWNER-n of kickoff/rehearsal-007/approvals.causa.json: {"decision_id": "OD-HC-nn", "action": "decide", "option": "<letter>", "pins": [{"path", "sha256"}]}. Written and committed by the owner only (RDP-003).

requests.title: Commission the historical-compatibility successor contract
requests.question: Commission a successor package whose event union keeps all 28 frozen v4.1.4 CoreEvent names, widens 9, adds 22, adds Provenance {OccurredAt; Actor; CorrelationId; FormatVersion; SemanticVersion} to EventEnvelope, pins payload records to the causa-storage v1.0.0 wire tables and adds VerificationFailure.ReaderStage, exactly as the pinned SUCCESSOR-CONTRACT.md and src/SuccessorContract.fs state?
options: A: commission it; an agent compiles the successor with X01-X21, an independent review follows, then FREEZE steps 1-5 and a tag
B: stay on v4.1.4 and record in advance that EXT-DATA-013 and EXT-DATA-005 cannot pass for the historical catalog
C: a different successor shape, which the owner specifies before any compile
requests.recommendation: A. Checks C11 and C15 prove it lossless on all 1,315 historical events and keep every frozen case name.
requests.rationale: No agent may add union cases or field names to a frozen package (ADRP-005-O4); a successor needs the owner's decision first (FREEZE.md step 1).
requests.impact: With B, 487 of the 1,315 historical events have no frozen case and no event keeps its provenance; the catalog journeys fail acceptance.

requests.title: Version number of the successor
requests.question: ODR-R10-20 (UI ownership rebalancing) and ODR-R10-25 (storage mirror) also name a v4.1.5. Which number does the historical-compatibility content take?
options: A: one combined v4.1.5 holding OD-HC-01 and whatever ODR-R10-20 and ODR-R10-25 approve
B: v4.1.5 holds OD-HC-01 only; UI ownership rebalancing becomes v4.1.6
C: UI ownership rebalancing is v4.1.5; OD-HC-01 becomes v4.1.6
requests.recommendation: A if both are approved for the same rehearsal (one freeze cycle instead of two); otherwise B.
requests.rationale: Two unrelated packages cannot share one number; 4.1.3 stays unused (withdrawn).
requests.impact: Sets the directory, tag and lock pin of every downstream artifact.

requests.title: Admissibility authority for the application's kernel
requests.question: causa-storage v1.0.0 §11.3 names the private engine's History.validate as the admissibility oracle, and OD-INDY-22 forbids copying it. 31 of the 35 engine-refused negative fixtures pass every check that does not need it (check C07). Where does the application's admissibility come from?
options: A: the requirements-derived kernel must refuse all 35 CAUSA.HISTORY_INADMISSIBLE negative fixtures with their expected domain codes; check C07 becomes its acceptance test
B: defer admissibility; historical cases load read-only on structural validity plus a reproduced snapshot (see OD-HC-04)
C: let the rehearsal use the engine as a released dependency (amends OD-INDY-22)
requests.recommendation: A for release acceptance, with B as the interim (OD-HC-04).
requests.rationale: A consumer that cannot evaluate admissibility must not report a history as valid (CONTRACT §11.3); EXT-DATA-005-O1 requires the F# admissibility pipeline.
requests.impact: Without A or C, Level C (authoritative reconstruction) cannot be claimed for any investigation.

requests.title: Read-only interim for the catalog cases
requests.question: Until OD-HC-03 A exists, may the application show the four catalog cases labelled 'read-only, admissibility not evaluated', verified by reader stages 1-14, 16 and 17 with the projection byte-identical to the engine snapshot and equal to the catalog expectedStateSha256, as the pinned REPLAY-VERIFICATION.md describes?
options: A: yes, labelled as such, with no writes to those cases and no 'verified' claim
B: no; nothing loads until admissibility is evaluated (EXT-DATA-005-O1 read literally)
requests.recommendation: A. It meets EXT-DATA-013's 'to the states recorded in the catalog manifest' and keeps §11.3's 'MUST NOT report a history as valid'.
requests.rationale: Separates what is proven (projection) from what is not (admissibility).
requests.impact: With B, the M2 read journeys wait for the full admissibility kernel.

requests.title: How the adapter reaches a rehearsal
requests.question: OD-INDY-22 forbids a rehearsal to copy code from earlier work. How does the verified decoder and projection reach the application (pinned INTEGRATION-HANDOFF.md §4)?
options: A: release it as a versioned package, as the Echelon tools are, and pin it in the dependency lock (route R1)
B: freeze CONTRACT §8.3 plus checks C02-C18 as owner-controlled verification assets; the rehearsal writes its own decoder and must pass them (route R2)
C: reference only; the rehearsal rebuilds the decoder from CONTRACT.md inside its window (route R3)
requests.recommendation: B. It keeps 'start from the requirements alone' and still gives the rehearsal an executable target. A if speed matters more than OD-INDY-22's intent.
requests.rationale: Each route needs the owner: a release, a frozen asset, or an explicit choice to rely on rehearsal time.
requests.impact: Determines whether the verified decoder is used before the competition.

requests.title: Content that causa-storage v1.0.0 cannot store
requests.question: The primary question (INV-023), observation source (INV-025), evidence label (INV-027), separate evidence URL (INV-029), relationship revise/withdraw (INV-030 update, INV-035, OD-INDY-23) and investigation rename/edit (INV-034, INV-035) have no v1.0.0 wire form (pinned SCHEMA-DIFF.md §6). What happens to them?
options: A: commission causa-storage 1.1.0 (CONTRACT §13.1 compatible additive extension) with the fields and events, plus matching successor cases
B: descope them from historical and read-only views now; keep them for new working-copy investigations only after A
C: drop the requirements
requests.recommendation: B now, then A. The historical cases do not contain these fields; inventing them would fabricate history.
requests.rationale: v1.0.0 refuses unknown data and has no extension namespace (CONTRACT §13.5).
requests.impact: Without A, journeys J1-03, J2-01, J2-03, J2-05, J2-06 and J2-09 cannot round-trip these fields.

requests.title: Rendering of the wire relationship kinds
requests.question: The wire relationship kind 'insufficient' (9 historical relationships) and 'discriminates' (0) have no INV-031 option, and INV-031's 'consistent-with' and 'inconclusive' have no wire value. How are historical relationships shown?
options: A: show 'insufficient' as 'inconclusive' for historical cases, read-only, never written back
B: show the wire kind verbatim as an extra read-only label
C: amend INV-031 to include the wire kinds
requests.recommendation: B, the only option that invents no meaning. A needs an explicit owner statement that the two mean the same.
requests.impact: Decides J2-04 on the catalog cases.
